scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and separate reproducible numerical crosschecks; no independent external assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nonzero initial radius, isotropic constant noise, outward linear drift and spherical exit; mean times only. The source establishes the first-order dimensional sign and the radial integral was previously known; the contribution is all-noise monotonicity/unimodality, the unique optimizer and planar exponentially small deficit. Broader earlier equivalent reductions remain possible.
title: All-noise escape-time phases for an outward Ornstein–Uhlenbeck diffusion
